notes:
BUILD 90
- The Big Rig: a semi tractor with a 36-slot box trailer, sold only at the Mechanic's Garage (1500 bare, 1900 assembled). It never turns up on the roads. The trailer hangs from the plate and trails behind: it swings wide of the corners the cab cuts, and folds up to about 80 degrees if you back it round too hard. E on the trailer opens it.
- Haulage jobs go up to 25,000. Freight that will not fit on you is loaded straight into your own vehicles parked within 40 m of the job board, so a truck or the Big Rig can take the big loads.
- The job board cards grow to fit their text: no more lines running into each other.
- Gas pumps work: drive a car, truck or helicopter of yours up to one and press E on the pump. It fills the tank with pumped Low Grade Fuel at 1 scrap per 20, up to 500, until you stop it, walk off, or run out of scrap. Pumped fuel stays in the tank (it cannot be taken out), and a pump will not fill a tank that has canned fuel or anything else in it.
- Animals bolt from vehicles with their engines running, and scientists and survivors step out of the way of anything coming at them. Nobody walks through a vehicle any more, and animals can no longer shove a car across the ground.
- Seat backs lean back instead of forward.
- The barrier and turret in front of the Outpost's motor pool bays are gone.
